column1: # Branded consensus (branded-consensus/4): the contents of generic curated made products from the ingredient statements of their US branded products in FoodData Central (FoodData_Central_branded_food_csv_2025-12-18, public domain), derived by Nom.Import --branded-consensus, never edited by hand.

# products: the matched products whose statement was read; stating: those that state the class (the gate's reading of the statement against the default criteria of the class's type, warnings left out); examples: up to three FDC ids that state it.
# verdict: usually when at least 0.75 of at least 10 products state it, split when more than 0.1 and less than that; a food or class with no row reads as its own data.

# class any, verdict read: the food was read from at least 10 statements, or at least 3 of its read statements, and three in four of them, name a single ingredient (then split on every class one of them states), so a class with no row is clear for it; a curated food of a made category (4, 6, 7, 8, 18, 19, 23) with no read row is of unknown contents for each class at least 0.1 of the read foods of its category state. category: the food's USDA category.
